prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background for an original indie dark-fantasy match-3 roguelike called Осколки.
Primary request: A wide panoramic crypt battle arena, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Ruined vaulted stone chamber with low mist, candles and a distant arched door. No characters. Keep the foreground at both left and right clear and open so separate game characters can be placed there.
Style/medium: hand-painted 2D storybook dark fantasy, chunky angular silhouettes, ink-edged shapes, restrained cel and gouache shading. Moody indie deckbuilding-game atmosphere, wholly original design.
Composition/framing: landscape panoramic stage viewed straight across the room, readable simple layered depth, floor in the lower third, ruined vault above.
Lighting/mood: dim candlelight and cool ambient shadows, mysterious and tense.
Color palette: charcoal, muted burgundy, aged ivory, small antique gold candle accents.
Constraints: no people, no monsters, no text, no UI, no lettering, no watermark. Single finished background raster illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character sprite for an original indie dark-fantasy match-3 roguelike called Осколки.
Primary request: Full-body anonymous cloaked wanderer in a faded burgundy hood and ivory armor, carrying a short sword. Facing RIGHT in a three-quarter battle-ready pose. Entire figure including sword and boots visible, fills most of a square canvas with small clean margins.
Style/medium: hand-painted 2D storybook dark fantasy, expressive chunky angular silhouette, ink-edged shapes, restrained cel and gouache shading. Moody indie deckbuilding-game atmosphere, wholly original design.
Color palette: faded burgundy, charcoal shadows, worn ivory armor, small antique gold fastenings.
Background: genuinely transparent background with real alpha channel; clean isolated character cutout ready for a game stage.
Constraints: one character only, no scenery, no floor, no shadow plane, no backdrop, no text, no UI, no watermark. Do not depict a checkerboard; the background must be actual transparency.
